intent.intent: Refresh the learning-playground's code examples: retire two older mock notebooks and add new ones covering German BM25, hybrid-index deletion, RRF reranking, OCR deskewing, and orchestrators, while tightening the teaching system prompt.
intent.summary: Removed the ai_billing_agent and bm25_index notebooks, added five new example notebooks (bm25_index_de, hybrid_index_delete, hybrid_rrf_rerank, ocr_deskew plus its sample image, orchestrators_101), rewrote learning-system-prompt.txt into a tighter teaching framework, and picked up incidental changes to the generated repo-map and pipeline-worker lock file.
intent.commitMessage: chore: refresh learning notebooks and teaching prompt

fileChanges.summary: Auto-generated repo index regenerated for the new worktree path and updated file list, no manual edits.
Generated pipeline-worker lock file's PID value bumped, no functional change.
Deleted the mock AI billing agent notebook (schema-constrained parser plus deterministic GOÄ/GOZ rules engine demo).
Deleted the original BM25 indexing example notebook.
Added a new notebook demonstrating BM25 indexing for German-language text (successor to the removed bm25_index notebook), content not directly inspectable in this environment.
Added a new notebook demonstrating deletion of documents from a hybrid (sparse+dense) search index, content not directly inspectable in this environment.
Added a new notebook demonstrating Reciprocal Rank Fusion reranking of hybrid search results, content not directly inspectable in this environment.
Added a sample grayscale prescription image used as OCR/deskewing input for the new ocr_deskew notebook.
Added a new notebook demonstrating OCR image deskewing using the accompanying sample prescription image, content not directly inspectable in this environment.
Added a new introductory notebook on orchestrators, content not directly inspectable in this environment.

Rewrote the Software Architecture teaching system prompt into a tighter structure, adding a 'walk one path start to finish' teaching step and subgraph guidance for multi-system diagrams, and condensing pacing/patience/format/boundary rules.

intent.riskReason: All changes are self-contained educational notebooks, a static image asset, a prompt text file, and generated bookkeeping files with no shared application code affected.
testScenarios: Open each new/changed notebook (bm25_index_de, hybrid_index_delete, hybrid_rrf_rerank, ocr_deskew, orchestrators_101) and confirm all cells execute top to bottom without errors.
Verify the sample prescription .webp image loads correctly and is referenced correctly by ocr_deskew.ipynb.
Confirm no other notebook or doc still links to the deleted ai_billing_agent.ipynb or bm25_index.ipynb paths.
Review learning-system-prompt.txt end to end to confirm the rewritten teaching rules are internally consistent (single diagram type per session, subgraph isolation, one-path walkthrough).
Confirm .claude/repo-map.md and .pipeline-worker/run.lock are regenerated/ignorable artifacts and not manually hand-edited content.
